earnings.intro: Buyers pay your Stripe account directly — SkillsetMind never holds your money.
earnings.details: This page is your earnings record: paid orders, what SkillsetMind charged, and your Stripe Connect status. Payout timing is Stripe's own and depends on your country, the payment method, and your Stripe account's payout schedule; a new account waits on verification before its first payout. Stripe Connect must have both charges and payouts enabled before a paid product can go live. Profile and security settings stay in Settings.

earnings.title: Your earnings, your payout setup.
earnings.helpBody: Buyers pay your Stripe account directly, so there is no platform hold. Stripe then settles and pays out to your bank on its own timing, which depends on your country and the payment method, and a new account waits on verification before its first payout. Stripe Connect must have both charges and payouts enabled before a paid product can go live.
earnings.bankNote: SkillsetMind never stores full bank details. Stripe collects identity, tax, and bank information inside the embedded onboarding flow.
earnings.activateTitle: Pay the one-time activation fee to start selling.
earnings.activateBody: Activation is charged once and unlocks course creation, publishing and payouts. After it clears you finish Stripe onboarding here, and buyers pay your Stripe account directly — SkillsetMind never holds your money.
earnings.connectTitle: Complete Stripe onboarding before selling paid courses.
earnings.connectBody: You stay on SkillsetMind the whole time. Stripe collects the legally required identity, tax, and bank details in this embedded step so your payout account meets payment regulations. After that, buyers pay your Stripe account directly: SkillsetMind never holds your money and there is no platform waiting period. Stripe pays out to your bank on your account's payout schedule — note that Stripe verifies new accounts before the very first payout.
earnings.statementsBody: One line per paid order — a record, not a wallet. The payouts themselves are made by Stripe out of your own balance, on your account's payout schedule.
earnings.ledgerEmpty: No entries yet. Each paid order adds a line here after checkout succeeds — and the money for it goes straight to your own Stripe balance, not to a SkillsetMind account.
earnings.taxCenterBody: Tax forms appear once you have real payout volume. Stripe Connect collects your tax details, and SkillsetMind keeps the payout ledger fully transparent.

pricing.four_plans_free_starts_at_10: Four plans. Free starts at 10% commission with no subscription. Starter drops it to 5%, Pro to 3%, Plus to 2%. Stripe's processing fee is shown separately so the math is never hidden, and buyers pay your own Stripe account directly — no platform hold, no platform clearing period.
pricing.pricing_that_lowers_as_you_grow: Pricing that lowers as you grow.
pricing.every_plan_can_sell_paid_plans: Every plan can sell. Paid plans lower the commission and raise your limits.
pricing.fee_to_activate_your_storefront_paid: fee to activate your storefront, paid once before your first course goes live. Free still has no monthly cost.
pricing.the_math_on_a_100_usd: The math, on a $100 USD sale
pricing.for_a_course_stripe_takes_its: for a course. Stripe takes its standard USD processing fee of
pricing.2_9_0_30_skillsetmind_takes: (2.9% + $0.30). SkillsetMind takes the plan's commission. The rest goes to you.
pricing.stripe_s_processing_fee_on_each: Stripe's processing fee on each successful charge (2.9% + $0.30 for USD cards, an estimated 5.4% + $0.30 for non-USD). Passed through to you on every plan.
pricing.what_is_the_stripe_processing_fee: What is the Stripe processing fee?
pricing.international_cards_non_usd_use_stripe: International cards (non-USD) use Stripe's international rate of 5.4% + $0.30 estimated instead of 2.9% + $0.30. Everything else is identical. Both figures are Stripe's US pricing — your own rates are the ones Stripe sets in the country your account is registered in.
pricing.days_of_purchase_if_they_ve: days of purchase if they've completed less than half the course and no certificate has been issued — once per course. A refund reverses the sale automatically, SkillsetMind's commission included.
pricing.buyers_pay_your_stripe_account_directly: Buyers pay your Stripe account directly. We never hold your money, so there is nothing for us to release — Stripe settles and pays out to your bank from your own Stripe balance on its own timing, which depends on your country and the payment method. A brand-new account waits on Stripe's verification before its first payout.
pricing.upgrade_any_time_new_commission_applies: Upgrade any time — new commission applies to new sales. Downgrade at the end of your billing cycle. Cancel anytime; you keep your content and revert to Free.
pricing.what_happens_when_i_upgrade_a: What happens when I upgrade a plan?
pricing.upgrades_apply_immediately_and_the_new: Upgrades apply immediately, and the new commission rate takes effect on new sales. Sales made before the change keep the commission rate from the plan you were on at the time. Stripe Billing prorates the subscription difference for the current cycle.
pricing.what_happens_when_i_downgrade_or: What happens when I downgrade or cancel?
pricing.downgrades_and_cancellations_take_effect: Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing period — you keep the plan you're paying for until then. If you cancel, you keep all your content and revert to Free ({value0}% commission, no subscription).
pricing.how_do_the_fees_work_on: How do the fees work on a subscription sale?
pricing.two_fees_come_out_of_each: Two fees come out of each sale, shown separately so the math is never hidden. SkillsetMind takes its plan commission (10% on Free down to 2% on Plus), and Stripe's standard processing fee (2.9% + $0.30 for USD cards, an estimated 5.4% + $0.30 for non-USD) is passed through to you. Everything left over is yours.
pricing.when_can_a_sale_be_refunded: When can a sale be refunded, and does it affect my payout?
pricing.learners_can_self_refund_within_days: Learners can self-refund within {value0} days of purchase if they've completed less than half the course. Because the buyer paid your Stripe account directly, the refund is debited from your own balance — and SkillsetMind's commission on that sale is returned to you with it, so you never pay a fee on a sale that was undone.
pricing.start_on_free_upgrade_only_when: Start on Free — upgrade only when the math works in your favor.

creators.buyers_are_charged_on_your_own: Buyers are charged on your own Stripe account — no platform hold on your money. Start free; upgrade to drop commission to 5%, 3%, or 2%.

promise.the_commission_rate_of_the_plan: The commission rate of the plan you sign up on is the rate you keep for the next 24 months — even if SkillsetMind raises plan pricing later. If SkillsetMind ever needs to change it, you get 90 days notice and the right to export everything and leave with no friction.
promise.if_a_creator_joins_on_free: If a creator joins on Free at 10%, that creator does not wake up to a surprise commission increase after building a business here.
promise.no_plan_ever_blocks_you_from: No plan ever blocks you from selling
promise.the_selling_engine_is_on_every: The selling engine is on every plan, Free included: publish courses, take checkout, drip content, run a community and live sessions, issue certificates, create unlimited coupons. Paid plans lower your commission and raise scale limits — students, video storage, featured slots, custom domains, team seats — and add branding controls like removing the SkillsetMind mark or putting your own logo on certificates. What upgrading never buys is permission to sell.
promise.a_creator_on_free_runs_a: A creator on Free runs a real business here. Upgrading buys a lower rate and more room, not the right to trade.
promise.at_any_moment_you_can_export: At any moment you can export your full business: courses with all videos and materials, your student list with progress, your sales history, your community posts, your event records. ZIP file. No calls. No retention attempts. No questions asked.
promise.skillsetmind_can_host_your_business_but: SkillsetMind can host your business, but SkillsetMind does not own the business you built.
promise.delete_your_account_in_one_click: Delete your account in one click. Your existing students keep access for the time they paid for, but no new enrollments will go through. SkillsetMind will not chain you in email loops, hide the cancel button, or send 12 different agents. SkillsetMind will simply do it.
promise.leaving_should_be_a_product_action: Leaving should be a product action, not a negotiation.
promise.your_buyers_pay_your_stripe_account: Your buyers pay your Stripe account directly — SkillsetMind is never a middleman for your money and has no balance of yours to freeze. Chargebacks below 1.5% rolling 90 days will never auto-suspend your account; above that threshold, review is human with a 72h SLA, not a black box. Disputes go to documented arbitration.

fees.self_serve_for_days_from_purchase: Self-serve for {value0} days from purchase, subject to course progress and certificate status. A refund is debited from your Stripe balance, and our commission on that sale is returned with it — you never pay a fee on a sale that was undone.
fees.there_is_no_platform_clearance_period: There is no platform clearance period, because there is nothing for us to clear. The sale lands in your own Stripe balance, and Stripe pays it to your bank on your connected account's payout schedule. The account is yours — but because it is a Stripe Express account opened through SkillsetMind, the payout interval is a platform setting rather than one you pick, and in some countries (Brazil included) the interval cannot be changed at all. Stripe applies its usual verification delay before a brand-new account's first payout, and settlement timing depends on your country and payment method. Marketplaces that collect your sales into their own account have to clear that money before they release it; we never collect it, so there is nothing to release.
fees.creators_connect_stripe_before_selling_a: Creators connect Stripe before selling any paid course. Checkout stays closed until your account can accept charges.

fees.as_merchant_of_record_you_carry: As merchant of record, you carry the chargeback. fees.skillsetmind_is_not_a_middleman_for: SkillsetMind is not a middleman for your money. Learners charge your Stripe account, Stripe deducts our commission at the moment of the sale, and the rest is already yours — no platform balance, no platform holding period, no waiting for us to remit.

0.q: How do students access a course?
0.a: After enrollment is confirmed, the course appears in the student learning portal under Classroom. Progress, lessons, and any community spaces tied to the course are reachable from there.

1.q: How do I create my SkillsetMind account?
1.a: Click Get started free on the homepage. You can sign up as a learner or jump straight to the teacher application from the For creators page. The same account works for learning and teaching.

0.a: Yes. Creators can draft and build products before professional verification is complete. Once their professional credential is approved and the product checks pass, they publish directly and public links, catalog visibility, and sales open immediately.

1.q: How should I choose course categories?
1.a: Choose the most specific category that matches the professional outcome first; it becomes the product's primary marketplace category. Add only genuinely relevant secondary categories so learners can discover the course without weakening its positioning.

2.q: How do I set pricing for my course?
2.a: Pricing is set per product inside Studio → course builder. Choose free enrollment, a one-time price, or a monthly or yearly subscription in a supported currency. The platform commission (10% on Free, 5% on Starter, 3% on Pro, 2% on Plus) plus the Stripe processing fee are shown clearly in the earnings ledger for every sale.

3.q: What is drip release and when should I use it?
3.a: Drip release lets you make lessons available on a schedule instead of all at once after enrollment. Useful for cohort-style programs or to pace learners across weeks. Configure per lesson in the course builder.

4.a: SkillsetMind verifies the professional rather than manually approving every course. Approved creators publish directly after the builder checks the course structure, price, payout setup, and public preview reference. Automated compliance checks may flag exceptional cases after publication without silently taking a product down.

0.q: Which plan should I start on?
0.a: Start on Free if you're validating an idea — there's no subscription and you keep 90% of every $100 sale before Stripe fees. Move to Starter ($19/mo, 5% commission) once you cross about $380/mo in sales. Pro and Plus pay back as you scale further. The pricing page lays out the break-even point for each plan.

1.q: What happens when I upgrade or downgrade?
1.a: Upgrades take effect immediately — the new commission applies to new sales right away (Stripe Billing prorates the subscription automatically). Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. Sales made under your old plan keep that plan's commission rate; the rate is snapshotted at the moment of sale.

2.q: What if I cancel my plan?
2.a: Cancellation downgrades you to Free at the end of your paid period. Your courses, students, content, and history are preserved — SkillsetMind never deletes a creator's data. Commission goes back to 10% (the Free rate) on new sales from the moment of downgrade.

0.q: When do I receive my first payout?
0.a: Your buyers pay your own Stripe account directly — you are the merchant of record, and SkillsetMind never holds or remits your money. There is no SkillsetMind clearing period, because we hold nothing. The timing is Stripe's: it pays out from your balance to your bank on the payout schedule of your connected account, and it applies its own settlement timing for your country and payment method. Stripe also holds a new connected account's first payout for a waiting period — typically 7 to 14 days, and up to 30 days in Brazil — that we cannot waive. Complete Stripe's identity verification and your first payout follows that schedule.

1.a: Stripe pays you from your own connected account; SkillsetMind is never in the middle. Every sale, our platform fee, and every refund is recorded in the earnings ledger inside Studio so you can reconcile it against your Stripe dashboard. Refunds and lost disputes are debited from your Stripe balance — and when a sale is refunded, our platform fee comes back to you with it.

0.a: Learners can request a refund within 7 days of purchase if they have completed less than half the course and have not received a certificate. The self-serve refund is available once per course; after that the request goes to support. The request is made directly from the order and processes automatically. Because the creator is the merchant of record, the refund is created on the creator's own Stripe account and debited from their Stripe balance — and SkillsetMind's platform fee on that sale is returned to the creator with it. The reversal is recorded in the creator's earnings ledger within minutes so it can be reconciled against their Stripe dashboard; the money movement itself is Stripe's, on the creator's own account.

Today's model supports external live links (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.) and recording upload workflows. Lessons can include a live session link plus a follow-up recording so learners who missed the live stay on track. Native live streaming is on the roadmap.

0.q: What integrations does SkillsetMind support today?
0.a: SkillsetMind connects natively with Stripe Connect: checkout and multi-currency payments run on the creator's own connected Stripe account, and Stripe pays the creator out from that account. Sign-in, media hosting, and file storage are built into the platform — nothing to set up. Need an integration you don't see yet? Contact support and we'll tell you where it sits on the roadmap.

promiseChangelog.title: Every Promise change belongs in public.
promiseChangelog.description: The SkillsetMind Creator Promise was published with a public changelog so creators can audit any future policy change before it affects their business.
promiseChangelog.publication: The SkillsetMind Creator Promise was published on {date}. One change has been made since publication, recorded below. Any future change will be documented here with date, diff, and reason at least 90 days before taking effect for existing creators.
promiseChangelog.changeTitle: Promise 05 replaced: “Funds protection by contract” became “We never hold your money”
promiseChangelog.whatChanged: What changed: course payments moved to Stripe direct charges. The buyer is now charged on the educator's own Stripe account, the educator is the merchant of record, and SkillsetMind takes its platform fee at the moment of the charge. The previous 30-day platform clearing period was removed, because SkillsetMind no longer receives or holds sale proceeds at all. Affiliate and co-producer revenue splits were removed with it: a platform that never touches the money cannot divide it.
promiseChangelog.why: Why: a promise to protect funds held by SkillsetMind is weaker than not holding them. Removing custody removes the failure mode the old promise was written to cover.
promiseChangelog.effectiveExisting: Effective for existing creators: {date}. The 90-day notice period did not apply, because the change took effect while no creator was selling under the previous promise, and because it removed a platform hold rather than adding one.
promiseChangelog.futureNew: Effective from: date for new creators.
promiseChangelog.futureExisting: Effective for existing creators: date, always at least 90 days from publication.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How SkillsetMind collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.text1: This policy explains what personal information SkillsetMind collects, why, who it is shared with, and the rights you have over it. It applies to visitors, learners, and educators. The data controller is Skillset USA, 26 Broadway, New York, NY 10006, United States ("SkillsetMind," "we," "us").
privacy.text2: Short version: we collect what the platform needs to run — your account, your learning activity, your purchases — plus product analytics you can opt out of. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.text3: Account data — name, email address, password (stored hashed by Supabase Auth), and your role on the platform (learner and/or educator).
privacy.text4: Profile data — information you add to your profile, such as a photo, bio, or professional background (for educators).
privacy.text5: Learning activity — courses you enroll in, lesson progress, certificates you earn, reviews you write, and posts in course communities and live sessions.
privacy.text6: Transaction data — order history, amounts, currency, and refund status. Payments are processed by Stripe; we receive confirmation and receipt metadata but never your full card number.
privacy.text7: Educator payout data — if you sell courses, the identity and banking information Stripe Connect requires for payouts is collected and held by Stripe under its own privacy terms; we see payout status and account state.
privacy.text8: Usage data — product analytics collected through PostHog: pages viewed, features used, device and browser type, and approximate location derived from IP.
privacy.text9: Cookies — described in Section 4 and controlled through the cookie banner.
privacy.text10: Communications — messages you send to support and notification preferences.
privacy.text11: Under the GDPR (EU/EEA/UK) and the LGPD (Brazil), each use of personal data needs a legal basis. Ours are:
privacy.text12: Performing our contract with you — creating and securing your account, delivering courses you enroll in, issuing certificates, routing purchases and refunds to the educator's Stripe account, and recording educator earnings.
privacy.text13: Legitimate interests — keeping the platform safe, preventing fraud and abuse, improving features based on aggregate usage, and sending service messages about your account and purchases.
privacy.text14: Consent — optional analytics cookies and marketing emails. You can withdraw consent at any time (cookie banner, unsubscribe link, or account settings) without affecting your use of the platform.
privacy.text15: Legal obligations — tax, accounting, and lawful requests from authorities.
privacy.text16: When you enroll in a course, the educator who runs it can see your name, email, enrollment date, and progress in their course — this is how they support their students. Under our public creator commitments ("The Promise"), each educator's student list belongs to that educator. Educators must handle student data lawfully and may not sell it; their obligations are set out in the <teacherTerms>Teacher Terms</teacherTerms>. When you buy a course, the educator is the merchant of record and the payment is charged on their own Stripe account, so the transaction — your name, email, the amount, currency, country, and the card brand and last four digits — appears in that educator's Stripe dashboard, where the educator is the controller of that record and Stripe's terms and the educator's own privacy notice apply. SkillsetMind never discloses your full card number to an educator, and educators do not see your activity in other educators' courses.
privacy.text17: We use strictly necessary cookies for sign-in sessions and language preference, and optional analytics cookies (PostHog) to understand how the product is used. The cookie banner lets you accept or reject the optional ones; strictly necessary cookies cannot be switched off because the platform does not work without them. Analytics data is used in aggregate and not to profile you for advertising.
privacy.text18: We never sell your personal information. We share it only with the service providers that run the platform, under contracts that limit what they can do with it:
privacy.text19: Supabase — authentication, database, and file storage (hosted in the United States).
privacy.text20: Stripe — payment processing and refunds (Stripe Connect). For educator subscriptions Stripe processes on our behalf; for a course purchase the charge is created on the educator's own connected account, where the educator is the merchant of record and Stripe acts for them. SkillsetMind does not receive or hold the purchase price.
privacy.text23: We may also disclose data when required by law, to protect the rights and safety of users, or as part of a corporate transaction (merger, acquisition), in which case this policy continues to apply to your data.
privacy.text24: Our infrastructure is hosted in the United States. If you access SkillsetMind from outside the US (including the EU/EEA, UK, or Brazil), your data is transferred to and processed in the US. For transfers from the EU/EEA and UK we rely on our providers' Standard Contractual Clauses and, where applicable, the EU-US Data Privacy Framework; for Brazil, on the LGPD's international-transfer provisions (art. 33). Data processing agreements with our infrastructure providers (Supabase, Stripe, Vercel) are incorporated into their respective service terms.
privacy.text25: We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purposes above:
privacy.text26: Account and learning data — while your account is active, and deleted or anonymized within 90 days after account deletion, except where retention is legally required.
privacy.text27: Certificates — the verification record persists so issued certificates remain verifiable, unless you ask us to remove it.
privacy.text28: Transaction records — kept for the period required by tax and accounting law (typically 5–10 years depending on jurisdiction).
privacy.text29: Analytics data — retained in identifiable form for no longer than 24 months.
privacy.text30: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest by our infrastructure providers. Access to production data is restricted, and database access is governed by row-level security policies so users can only read what belongs to them. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects your personal data we will notify you and the competent authority as required by law (including GDPR art. 33/34 and LGPD art. 48).
privacy.text31: You can exercise any of these rights by emailing <support>support@skillsetmind.com</support> or from your account settings. We respond within the timeframe required by your law (30 days under GDPR, 15 days for confirmation and access requests under LGPD, 45 days under CCPA). We will never discriminate against you for exercising a privacy right.

privacy.text35: You have the rights set out in article 18 of the LGPD: confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization or deletion of unnecessary or excessive data, portability, deletion of data processed with consent, information about sharing and about the consequences of refusing consent, and revocation of consent. refund.text1: SkillsetMind is the marketplace and checkout for online courses sold by independent educators; the educator who published a course is its seller and merchant of record. refund.text3: You may request a full refund of a course purchase within {days} days of the purchase date. There is no fee to request a refund inside this window. The refund goes back to your original payment method.
